items.label: 3-Piece Outdoor Set
items.value: This outdoor furniture set comprises a pair of chairs and a coffee table, all made from PE rattan and framed by powder-coated iron, offering a natural, minimalist aesthetic. It’s a practical complement to your outdoor living space, blending style and comfort

items.label: Thick Cushions
items.value: This set comes with two thick cushions that enhance the comfort of the rattan chairs. Made with breathable 180g polyester and high-density foam, they’re soft, durable, and resistant to deformation. The removable covers are machine washable, wich is simple to refresh during seasons

items.label: Extra-Stable Structure
items.value: This patio chair and table set is built for enhanced stability. The frame and legs are crafted into a simple, integrated structure, ensuring the chairs and table are exceptionally stable while maintaining a sleek, clean-lined design

items.label: Tempered-Glass Tabletop
items.value: The tabletop is made of 5 mm thick tempered glass, known for its great transparency, high hardness, and excellent scratch resistance. The crystal top brings an airy visual aesthetic to the dark-colored table, balancing the darker tones and making the whole set more dynamic

items.label: Hand-Woven HDPE Rattan
items.value: This garden coffee table set is crafted from polyester using traditional weaving techniques, exuding the unique charm of handmade craftsmanship. Known for its excellent weather and wear resistance, HDPE rattan retains both durability and appearance after prolonged outdoor exposure

items.label: Material
items.value: HDPE, Iron, 180g Polyester, Foam, Tempered Glass

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assembly required. Follow the provided instructions to set up the table and chairs.
